rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the loose, unstrained part of a rope, sail, or similar thing.

example.english: There’s still some slack in the rope; it isn’t taut yet.
example.traditional: 條繩仲有啲鬆位，未拉實。
example.jyutping: tiu4 sing4 zung6 jau5 di1 sung1 wai6 mei6 laai1 sat6

rows.note: This is the everyday choice for deliberately not working as hard as expected.

example.english: They slack at work, so they never finish their tasks.
example.traditional: 佢哋成日偷懶，搞到啲工作成日都做唔完。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 tau1 laan5 gaau2 dou3 di1 gung1 zok3 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 m4 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when something becomes less tight or comes loose, rather than when someone avoids work.

example.english: The shoelace went slack; help me tie it tighter.
example.traditional: 條鞋帶鬆開咗，你幫我綁返實啲。
example.jyutping: tiu4 haai4 daai2 sung1 hoi1 zo2 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bong2 faan2 sat6 di1

rows.note: Use this for a dip or low spot in a surface, such as an uneven section of track or flooring.

example.english: There’s a dip in this stretch of road—a slack spot—so drive slowly.
example.traditional: 呢段路有個凹位，揸車經過要慢啲。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 lou6 jau5 go3 nap1 wai6 zaa1 ce1 ging1 gwo3 jiu3 maan6 di1

rows.note: Use this for a quiet or slow period in business, trade, or activity.

example.english: Business has been slack lately, and it is really hard to make money.
example.traditional: 最近市道好淡，做生意真係難做。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 si5 dou6 hou2 taam5 zou6 saang1 ji3 zan1 hai6 naan4 zou6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something physical is loose, lax, or not pulled tight.

example.english: This rope is not pulled tight; it is still slack.
example.traditional: 呢條繩未拉實，仲有啲鬆。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 mei6 laai1 sat6 zung6 jau5 di1 sung1

rows.note: Use this for a person or work attitude that is lazy, careless, or lacking in diligence.

example.english: How can you get good results when you are so slack in your work?
example.traditional: 你做嘢咁懶散，點會有好成績？
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 laan5 saan2 dim2 wui5 jau5 hou2 sing4 zik1
